name: Air Distribution Systems
summary:
Air Distribution Systems is an immersive VR training application developed by ImmerseLearn to enhance practical learning in HVAC air distribution. Designed as part of the Air Distribution Systems micro-credential program, this application enables learners to engage in realistic, scenario-based training that builds critical skills in system components, airflow management, and installation practices.
